BACKSTABBED_FORWARD: The victim half of the two-handed backstab, and reachable in play — it is what an enemy does when a greatsword or battleaxe takes them from behind. Not yet reviewable in a scenario: staging one needs the player's weapon swapped before the clock starts, and the harness equips during the run, so the critical either fires before the pack has arrived (and plays the one-handed pairing) or late enough that the victim has turned out of position. Excluded rather than covered by a scene that would be asserting the wrong thing. The fix is scenario staging, not the clip.
GREATAXE_RIPOSTE: Built but not played. The haft family declares an execution and the two classes that carry it (battleaxe, warhammer) are criticalStyle 'swing' — an axe has no point, so it ripostes and backstabs with its own opening light attack instead (equipment/movesets/criticals.ts). Kept in the pack because the clip belongs to the family rather than the class: a haft weapon with a point would use it. Its swing replacement is reviewed by greataxe-riposte.
